faq.question: What does Rashedul mean?

faq.answer: Rashedul is associated with Arabic. Rashedul is the Bengali form of Arabic رَاشِدُ الدِّين (Rāshid al-Dīn), meaning 'rightly guided in the faith'.

faq.question: Is Rashedul an Arabic name?
